items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: But Boleg was a man that, he used to go in the picture show... He used to have pit bands.

ctx.x: I've heard the name, but I can't place him. I'm thinking about a saxophone. And he was a good drummer, Joe Walker, huh?

Joe Walker was a rudiment drummer. Clyde know what I'm talking about. He mostly played, he played everything by music, rudiments. Everything was rudiments. But Boleg was a man that, he used to go in the picture show and those days they didn't have no sound pictures and he'd catch everything that'd go on. He had everything on the drums, all kinds of things. See, like a man be, you know, somebody be whistling on the television, he'd whistle. In the movie? Yeah, crickets. Yeah. Yeah, he'd catch that. He used to have…

Well, let's see now. Some of the other guys. Buddy Caieri or something like that. I never have known how you pronounce that name. Who? I've seen this written down. K-Y-E-R-I. Buddy Caieri? I don't even know what he played, but he's supposed to play with Clayman Williams.
